result.title: Harnessing VLM in Embodied RL: From Reward Regressor to Success Detector via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating
result.summary: VLMs provide promising solutions to embodied reward design. Most current methods that train VLMs as reward regressors not only require extensive annotations but are also primarily designed for finetuning pretrained policies, and perform less well in the more challenging from-scratch RL setting. This issue stems from a fundamental mismatch: regressing precise rewards is misaligned with what VLMs naturally excel at. We posit that it is more aligned with VLMs' inherent multi-modal VQA capabilities for the models to function as success detectors, and propose VLM success reward via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating (VLMeg) to well harness VLM for embodied reward design. As the core of VLMeg, the proposed exploration-augmented key-observation gating first determines whether the current RL episode is judgment-worthy based on its similarity to a generated success trajectory. Then, the key observation with the lowest confusion from the judgment-worthy episode will be selected for VLM evaluation as episodic reward. This gating mechanism not only avoids redundant calls but also enables higher detection accuracy of VLM. Considering the sparsity of judgment-worthy episodes, the advanced exploration incentives based on the generated trajectory are introduced, enabling more efficient exploration toward judgment-worthy trajectories for more VLM reward triggers and thus gaining higher RL efficiency. Extensive experiments in MetaWorld demonstrate VLMeg achieves state-of-the-art from-scratch RL, outperforming advanced VLM-based baselines on 12 challenging reward-free tasks. Furthermore, VLMeg also enables effective RL without any ground-truth reward in 3 challenging real-world experiments. Code will be open after acceptance at https://github.com/Raina915/VLMeg.

AI.brief_summary: 论文认为让 VLM 回归精确奖励与其能力不匹配，转而把 VLM 当作成功检测器：提出 VLMeg，先用当前 episode 与生成成功轨迹的相似度做「值得判定」门控，再从中挑出混淆度最低的关键观测交给 VLM 评估，作为情节奖励，并配合探索激励提高触发频率，在 MetaWorld 与真实环境中验证从零训练 RL。
AI.relevance_reason: 关键观测的相似度门控与低混淆筛选是一条具体的视觉证据筛选线索，或可对照 LVR 中「何时调用视觉证据、选取哪个观测（LOOK/STOP 决策）」的问题；但研究主线是具身 RL 奖励设计，与 latent 推理状态的关联需核查。
